Death Pact.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Dream Shield.descriptionOnly: the +4 while awake; while asleep, spell resistance 10 + caster level against mind-affecting effects is told here

Ectoplasmic Hand.descriptionOnly: no path: the hand's hardness 10, hit points 10 + caster level, AC 24 (+6 natural armor, +8 size) and CMB are its own; the +2 on a touch attack it delivers is at the table

Mantle of Doubt.descriptionOnly: no path: the –4 on the save and the –2 on saves against mind-affecting effects are those of the creatures that fail against it

Phantom Limb.descriptionOnly: extra arms' two claw attacks are told here

Psychic Leech.descriptionOnly: no path: the +2 enhancement to Strength and Dexterity is the caster's, while the fatigued target is in range

Psychonaut Manifestation.descriptionOnly: the ability is rolled at random, and rolled again on a successful Will save

Sensory Amplifier.descriptionOnly: on the creatures in the area other than you; their low-light vision, scent and the extra 2d6 damage are told here
